name: The Reality Chip
clause: As long as ~ is attached to a creature, you may play lands and cast spells from the top of your library.

needs.proposedSignature: Extend the static: { kind: 'cast-from'; zone: 'graveyard' | 'exile' | 'library-top'; filter?: Filter; free?: true; condition?: Condition }, and give play-lands-from a condition?: Condition.
needs.semantics: 'As long as ~ is attached to a creature, you may play lands and cast spells from the top of your library' (The Reality Chip) needs both halves under one condition; today play-lands-from covers only lands and takes no condition, and cast-from cannot name the library.
needs.clause: As long as ~ is attached to a creature, you may play lands and cast spells from the top of your library.

needs.proposedSignature: A face declaration { reconfigure: ManaCost } with a matching covers kind 'reconfigure' (anchored line ^reconfigure (\{.+\})$, value = reconfigure.raw), plus KEYWORD_EXPANSIONS 'reconfigure': '{cost}: attach ~ to target creature you control; or unattach ~. activate only as a sorcery. while attached, ~ is not a creature'.
needs.semantics: Equipment-creature attach / unattach at sorcery speed; while attached the permanent is not a creature. Scripting it as a plain sorcery-speed attach-self activated ability (what all four scripts do) is correct behaviour, but the printed line then has neither a declaration nor rules text, so it scores 0 and the card can never be verified.
